adjudication_u3.ch_reason: I reach the same classifications. 30916695 is QOP's exact ODS name with 206 mentions, so it is SAME and eligible; the GB-NHS-TBC raw is junk, and TBC is not an ODS code. 1850341 'NHS Greater Manchester' is UNSURE, a mixed cluster. I placed its id (1.85M) in 2011-12 by comparing ids of orgs whose names date them: Bolton NHS FT, named 2011, is 1.78M; Oxford Health is 1.86M; University Hospital Southampton FT, named October 2011, is 2.18M; the 2013-14 CSUs are 3.3-6.3M; HIOW ICB is 20.9M. So its first mention is the 2011-13 'NHS Greater Manchester' PCT cluster, which predates QOP's 2017 ODS start. Its 4 coded FTS mentions are QOP's own ICB brand. The check ties it with 0AJ and ORD holds no rename record, so it cannot be a member either way. The UNSURE rule makes the decision hold. 8572709 'NHS England Greater Manchester' is DIFFERENT: its id (8.57M) dates it to about 2015, and the name belongs to NHS England's GM area team (X24). 31620840, the joint label 'NHS England and NHS Greater Manchester ICP', names two bodies, NHS England and the ICP joint committee. Whether it is classed HOSTED_OR_SITE or as a consortium, it is not a member. Once 1850341 is resolved, the 1-member verdict on 30916695 is the expected outcome.
